author: /root/morph_review
scope: Root-owned syntax and isolated gate validation remain separate. These are design cases, not executed evidence and not assertion-location claims.

cases.change: Use the unbound root-input template.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Provide a different raw hash for the selected root input.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Change a frozen native source member or its complete pin.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Name /root/morph_review as the native source reviewer.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Change the source acceptance inventory path, bytes or hash.
cases.expected: Reject the unequal complete pin.

cases.change: Select another binding path, byte length or hash.
cases.expected: Reject before native execution.

cases.change: Change any of the 12,443 actual-binding input bytes.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Omit a source pin or introduce an unpinned file in a complete copy root.
cases.expected: Reject the independently derived exact closure or exact directory comparison.

cases.change: Supply failed/missing preparation, wrong final status or a retained failed-attempt marker.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Change any actual prepared artifact named by the receipt.
cases.expected: Reject its full raw pin.

cases.change: Omit or duplicate a target, change its path, bytes, preimage, artifact or afterimage identity.
cases.expected: Reject the complete target closure, exact artifact pin or preimage linkage.

cases.change: Use /root/recover_delivery, /root/runtime_recovery or /root as the independent afterimage reviewer.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Change any complete binding, preparation or frozen preparation-source pin covered by afterimage acceptance.
cases.expected: Reject the exact acceptance mismatch.

cases.change: Omit a complete donor history or the actual delivered bag resource from the copied closure.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Leave Godot unbound, choose a relative/PATH command, symlink, non-executable extension or wrong byte pin.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Dispatch with an existing execution-r01, including a failed attempt.
cases.expected: Reject without overwriting or retrying it.

cases.change: A root-owned isolated execution encounters spawn error, signal or nonzero status.
cases.expected: Retain available logs and command status; rehash every protected input and completed copy; retain failure receipt.

cases.change: The actual suite exits zero without one positive-check, zero-failure summary, or prints ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR/FAIL.
cases.expected: Fail the attempt, retain logs and run the unconditional postchecks.

cases.change: A child changes an original input, completed isolated copy, executable or required production absence.
cases.expected: Attempt every recheck, retain all errors, fail the attempt and run the final recheck.

cases.change: A copy fails after some isolated files have been written.
cases.expected: Retain planned and completed copy manifests, rehash all protected inputs and completed copies, and preserve a failed one-shot attempt.

cases.change: Use a repair input with any contract change from the exact reviewed d5704d contract.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Provide familiar r04 preparation statuses without successful correction receipt, completed attempt, full output manifest and successful root dispatch witness.
cases.expected: Reject before candidate output creation or child execution.

cases.change: Leave a failure.json in the external repair attempt.
cases.expected: Reject even if preparation-looking files exist.

cases.change: Change any seventh output, any second target afterimage, or the exact safe-only source correction.
cases.expected: Reject the full output comparison, restored plan, restored ledger or exact source derivation.

cases.change: Omit or alter original r03 source acceptance, failed r01 evidence, correction lineage or the output acceptance correction pin object.
cases.expected: Reject the missing historical gates or full raw pin mismatch.
